sources.title: GitHub - anthropics/jacobian-lens: Companion code for the global ...
sources.snippet: The Jacobian lens reads out what an internal activation is disposed to make the model say. It linearly transports a residual-stream vector at any layer and position into the final-layer basis, then decodes it with the model's own unembedding into a ranked list of vocabulary tokens.

sources.title: qwen3-32b | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Qwen3-32B is a large language model from the Qwen3 series. It features 32.8 billion parameters, a 131K token context window, support for 100+ languages, and hybrid thinking modes allowing switching between deep reasoning and fast responses. It demonstrates strong performance in reasoning, instruction-following, and agent capabilities.
